title: The Horizon of Station Meridian
premise: Ivo Ashgrove, a memory-smuggler hauling contraband recollections through the contested orbits of Station Meridian, survives a nine-second system-wide gravity flicker that no one else seems to remember. Digging into a smuggled memory-core, Ivo uncovers evidence of the Kestrel Reach massacre—three hundred colonists erased from every official record—and realizes the flicker was a weapon test by the Meridian Combine to wipe collective memory itself. Hunted by customs enforcer Sefa Rell, who becomes both adversary and reluctant ally, Ivo must broadcast the truth before the Combine's second, permanent pulse erases them and everyone who remembers. In the end, Ivo sacrifices their own smuggled memories of the person they loved most to power the broadcast, saving the truth at the cost of ever knowing why it mattered.
about_author: Marguerite Sandoval is a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloging shipping manifests before turning to fiction about what gets lost in transit. She writes from a converted lighthouse keeper's cottage on the Atlantic coast.

chapters.title: Nine Seconds of Falling
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Mid-run through Meridian's customs corridor, gravity fails for exactly nine seconds; cargo drifts, a guard dies, and Ivo alone seems shaken when no one else recalls it happening. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath practiced calm.

chapters.title: The Weight of Contraband
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Back at the dockside den, Ivo inventories a black-market memory-core salvaged during the flicker—a child's recollection of fire falling on Kestrel Reach. Emotional beat: curiosity curdling into unease.

chapters.title: Paper Moons
chapters.summary: Sefa Rell's POV. The customs enforcer investigates the dead guard and finds her own incident logs rewritten overnight. Emotional beat: institutional loyalty beginning to crack.

chapters.title: What the Core Remembers
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Playing the core through a jury-rigged deck, Ivo experiences the massacre firsthand: three hundred colonists, orbital bombardment, then white silence. Emotional beat: grief for strangers.

chapters.title: The Client Who Wasn't
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The broker who commissioned the run has been memory-wiped into vacancy; his ledger points to the Meridian Combine's orbital foundry. Emotional beat: hunter becoming hunted.

chapters.title: Interrogation by Lamplight
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa corners Ivo but finds the evidence too coherent to dismiss; she lets them go and falsifies her report for the first time. Emotional beat: betrayal of self.

chapters.title: Kestrel Reach, Population Zero
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo flies to the colony site and finds a pristine, uninhabited world—no ruins, no graves, not even dust out of place. Emotional beat: gaslit vertigo.

chapters.title: The Archivist of Drift
chapters.summary: New character Odile Vann's POV. A retired Combine memory-archivist living in the debris belts recognizes the flicker signature as 'the Loom,' a mass-erasure engine. Emotional beat: guilt seeking penance.

chapters.title: Twelve Years Invisible
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Interleaved flashback: how Ivo became a smuggler after the Combine disappeared their partner, Juno—and why those memories are all they have left. Emotional beat: love as contraband.

chapters.title: A Warrant in Every Port
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa is ordered to arrest Ivo or be wiped herself; she burns her credentials instead and goes dark. Emotional beat: duty inverted.

chapters.title: The Loom Explained
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile reveals the nine-second flicker was a calibration failure—the full pulse will rewrite every mind in the system simultaneously. Emotional beat: apocalyptic clarity.

chapters.title: Smuggling a Witness
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo, Sefa, and Odile plan to hijack the Combine's own relay network to broadcast the Kestrel core system-wide before the pulse fires. Emotional beat: fragile alliance.

chapters.title: The Price of Passage
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. To reach the relay hub they need a Combine clearance chip, which means robbing a memory-broker who deals in stolen identities. Emotional beat: moral compromise.

chapters.title: Ghosts in the Manifest
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Inside Combine archives, Sefa finds her own childhood records altered—her hometown was also erased. Emotional beat: personal devastation hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Foundry
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The heist goes wrong; Odile is captured buying time, and Ivo learns the pulse launches in seventy-two hours. Emotional beat: rage and loss.

chapters.title: What Odile Gave
chapters.summary: Odile's POV, captive. Interrogated by Combine director Halvard Crane, Odile feeds him false coordinates while secretly transmitting the core's checksum to Ivo. Emotional beat: defiance without hope.

chapters.title: The Long Fall to Meridian
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A desperate burn through military traffic toward the relay hub, with Sefa flying cover in a stolen cutter. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into purpose.

chapters.title: Crane's Offer
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Cornered by Crane, Ivo is offered amnesty and Juno's restored memories in exchange for silence. Emotional beat: temptation at its most human.

chapters.title: The Broadcast
chapters.summary: Sefa and Ivo's alternating POV. They seize the relay hub under fire; the Kestrel massacre floods every screen and implanted feed across the system. Emotional beat: triumph shadowed by cost.

chapters.title: Nine Seconds Again
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Crane triggers an emergency partial pulse; the only way to shield the broadcast is to route it through a human memory buffer—Ivo's own. Emotional beat: sacrifice chosen freely.

chapters.title: The Horizon of Station Meridian
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. The pulse collapses; Crane falls; the truth stands. Sefa finds Ivo alive but hollowed—staring at Juno's photograph like a stranger's face. Emotional beat: salvation and sorrow entwined.

chapters.title: Cargo Worth Carrying
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, epilogue. Months later, Ivo runs honest freight past Meridian, carrying a blank core they've begun filling with new memories—starting with Sefa retelling them everything they lost. Emotional beat: grief becoming inheritance.
